name: Crate template (crate-kit)
postAttachCommand:
echo '
  Dataset crate ready. Try:
    pixi shell         # enter the env (then use `crate` directly)
    crate build .      # scan the repo into the crate
    crate enrich .     # resolve ORCIDs / DOIs
    crate validate .   # check it
    crate render . -o _site
'
